text_to_speech: I think you learn a lot from good leaders. I think you learn a lot from bad leaders. And you learn a lot about yourself by looking at your own leadership style through that lens. I've been very fortunate over the years to learn from both sorts of leaders and I find that now as the Chief I continue to learn and I hope that's something that our people realise as we continue to invest in the leadership at all levels of our Navy.

youtube_description:
Chief of Navy, Vice Admiral Mike Noonan, shares his thoughts on leadership in the Royal Australian Navy.

This is one of the subjects he talks about in a comprehensive interview in the August 9 edition of Navy News.

Read the full article at http://www.defence.gov.au/news/navynews
